description: This Java source file provides utility methods for handling a mini-language within the OFBiz framework, including script detection, method invocation, type conversion, document correction flagging, and document serialization.

classes.name: MiniLangUtil
classes.description: Utility class for handling mini-language scripts, method invocation, type conversion, document correction flags, and document serialization within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: containsScript
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a script prefix from the predefined set.

methods.name: autoCorrectOn
methods.description: Determines if the mini-language script engine is configured to auto-correct version changes based on properties.

methods.name: callMethod
methods.description: Invokes a specified method reflectively on a given object with provided parameters, handling exceptions.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts an object to a specified target class, considering locale, timezone, and format.

methods.name: flagDocumentAsCorrected
methods.description: Marks an XML document as corrected by setting user data.

methods.name: getObjectClassForConversion
methods.description: Returns a suitable class for conversion based on the object type, defaulting to PlainString for null or String.

methods.name: isConstantAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an attribute value is a constant (no expressions).

methods.name: isConstantPlusExpressionAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an attribute value is a constant or a constant plus expression.

methods.name: isDocumentAutoCorrected
methods.description: Checks if an XML document has been marked as auto-corrected.

methods.name: writeMiniLangDocument
methods.description: Serializes an XML document to a file with styling via an XSLT stylesheet.
